description: Land Title Settlement Department - Keppetiwalana, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 520201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
